title: Amazon Automated Resume Scoring Gender Disparity
system_purpose: Scored applicant resumes from 1 to 5 stars for technical roles
decision_impact: Influenced recruiter recommendation and interview shortlist ordering
affected_groups: Female applicants; graduates of women colleges
verified_facts: Machine learning model trained on 10-year historical resume datasets penalised terms like womens and names of womens colleges
reported_harm: Systemic gender bias in applicant triaging resulting in lower candidate ratings for female applicants
quantitative_evidence: Engineers edited model to remove 28 explicit gender terms but model regenerated implicit demographic proxies
limitations: Internal project trial disbanded prior to production release; full internal metrics remain proprietary

title: Algorithmic Pre-Employment Assessment Adverse Impact
system_purpose: Parsed video interview responses and resume text keyword density
decision_impact: Disqualified applicants prior to human recruiter resume review stage
affected_groups: Non-native English speakers; applicants with non-traditional career paths
verified_facts: EEOC technical guidance highlighted risk of AI selection tools penalizing candidates with speech variations or non-standard formatting
reported_harm: Unjustified exclusion of qualified job seekers due to keyword matching failures and acoustic variance
quantitative_evidence: EEOC guidelines require compliance with four-fifths rule (80% impact ratio) for selection procedures
limitations: Aggregated guidance report reflecting multi-vendor audit findings across employment software products
